senses.gloss: स्फुजि-ध्वज m. N. of an astronomer, VarBṛ., Sch.
स्फुट्ट् cl. 10. P. स्फुट्टयति, to despise, disrespect, Dhātup. xxxii, 37 (Vop.)
स्फुट mfn. open, opened, Suśr.; BhP.
expanded, blossomed, blown, MBh.; Uttarar.
plain, distinct, manifest, evident, clear, MBh.; VarBṛS. &c.
(in astron.) apparent, real, true, correct, Sūryas.
spread, diffused, extensive, wide, broad, Kum.; Bhartṛ.; Śiś.
extraordinary, strange, Kpr.
full of, filled with, possessed by (instr. or comp.), Divyāv.; Lalit.
white, L.
स्फुट m. the expanded hood of a serpent, L. (also f(आ). , Pañcat.)
स्फुट m. N. of a man g. अश्वादि
स्फुटम् (अम्), ind. distinctly, evidently, certainly, Kāv.; Kathās.
स्फुट—करण n. N. of wk.
स्फुट—चन्द्र-तारक mf(आ)n. radiant with the moon and stars (said of night), Kum.
स्फुट—चन्द्रिका f. N. of wk.
स्फुट—ज्योतिष n. N. of wk.
स्फुट—तर mfn. more (or most) distinct or clear (अम् ind.), Śiś.
स्फुट—तार mfn. having stars clearly seen, bright with stars, MW.
स्फुट—तरम् (अम्), ind.
स्फुट—त˚राक्षर mfn. having very clear words, perfectly clear or intelligible (cf. स्फुटाक्ष्˚), ib.
स्फुट—ता f. manifestness, distinctness (acc. with √ गम्, ‘to become manifest or evident’), Bhaṭṭ.; Kir.
reality, truth, correctness (in अ-स्फ्˚), Gol.
स्फुट—त्व n. the being open, openness, Suśr.
manifestness &c. (see -ता), Śaṃk.; Sarvad.; Gaṇit.
स्फुट—दर्पण m. N. of an astron. wk. by Nārāyaṇācārya.
स्फुट—पुण्डरीक n. the expanded (lotus of the) heart, Bcar. i, 9.
स्फुट—पौरुष mfn. one who has displayed energy, MW.
स्फुट—फल m. coriander or the fruit of Diospyros Embryopteris (= तुम्बुरु), L.
स्फुट—फल n. (in geom.) clear or precise result (of any calculation)
distinct or precise area (of a triangle &c.)
स्फुट—फेन-राजि m. (the sea) bright with lines of foam, Kum.
स्फुट—बन्धनी v.l. for -वल्कली.
स्फुट—बुद्बुद Nom. P. स्फुटबुद्बुदति, to apparently resemble a water-bubble, Kāv.
स्फुट—बोध m. N. of a Vedānta wk.
स्फुट—रङ्गिणी f. Cardiospermum Halicacabum, Subh.
स्फुट—वक्तृ mfn. speaking distinctly or frankly, Cāṇ.
स्फुट—वल्कली f. Cardiospermum Halicacabum, Subh.
स्फुट—विवरण n. N. of an astron. wk. by Rudra-miśra.
स्फुट—शब्दम् ind. with a clear sound, distinctly, audibly, Śiś.
स्फुट—सार m. (prob.) the true latitude of a star or planet, MW.
स्फुट—सिद्धान्त m. N. of an astron. wk.
स्फुट—सूर्य-गति f. apparent or true motion of the sun, MW.
स्फुटाक्षर mfn. having clear words, perspicuous (as speech), Ratnāv.
स्फुटागस् mfn. sinning openly (in the sight of every one), Śiś.
स्फुटार्थ m. clear sense or meaning, Śak., Sch.
स्फुटार्थ mfn. having clear sense, perspicuous, intelligible (-ता f.), Śiś.
स्फुटार्थ—ता f.
स्फुटन n. bursting, opening, expanding, Vāgbh.; Śatr.
cracking (of the joints &c.), Car.
स्फुटनीय mfn. to be broken open or split, MW.

स्फुटि or स्फुटी, f. cracking or chapping of the skin of the feet, L.;
 the fruit of the Karkaṭī or Cucumis Momordica, L.

स्फुटि or स्फुटी, f. cracking or chapping of the skin of the feet, L.;
 the fruit of the Karkaṭī or Cucumis Momordica, L.
स्फुटी in comp. for स्फुट.
स्फुटिका f. a small bit or fragment, Daś.
स्फुटित mfn. burst, budded, blown &c.
laughed at (= परि-हसित; cf. √ स्फुण्ट्), MW.
स्फुटित—चरण mfn. having too flat or wide feet, splay-footed, ib.
स्फुटी—करण n. the act of making clear or evident, manifestation, Kād.; Śaṃk.
making true or correct, correction, Sūryas.

स्फुटी—√ कृ P. -करोति, to make clear or evident or manifest, Kād.; Pratāp.;
to sharpen (the senses), Car.
स्फुटी—भाव m. becoming clear or evident, Nyāyam.
स्फुटी—√ भू P. -भवति, to become evident or manifest, Naiṣ.; Sarvad.
स्फुड् cl. 6. P. स्फुडति, to cover, Dhātup. xxviii, 97.

स्फुण्ट् cl. 1. P. स्फुण्टति, to open, expand, Dhātup. ix, 44;
 cl. 10. P. स्फुण्टयति, to jest, joke, laugh (v.l. for next), ib. xxxii, 4.

स्फुण्ड् cl. 1. Ā. स्फुण्डते, to open, expand, Dhātup. viii, 25;
 cl. 10. P. स्फुण्डयति, to jest &c. (cf. prec.), ib. xxxii, 4.
स्फुत् an imitative sound (cf. फुत्), L.
स्फुत्—कर mfn. making a crackling sound (said of fire), MW.
स्फुत्—कार m. a crackling sound, L.
स्फुर् [cf. Gk. σπαίρω, σϕυρόν; Lat. sperno; Lith. spìrti; Germ. sporo, spor, Sporn; Eng. spur, spurn.]
2. स्फुर् (ifc.) quivering, trembling, throbbing, Śiś. ii, 14.
स्फुर mfn. id., Pañcat.
स्फुर m. quiver, throb &c. (in स-स्फुर, ‘throbbing’ i.e. ‘living’), Bhaṭṭ.
= (and v.l. for) स्फर, a shield, L.
स्फुरण mfn. glittering, sparkling, VarBṛS.
स्फुरण n. the act of trembling, throbbing, vibration, pulsation (also f(आ). ), Dhātup.; L.
स्फुरण n. quivering or throbbing of parts of the body (as indicating good or bad luck), MW.
springing or breaking forth, starting into view, expansion, manifestation, Sāh.; BhP.; Sarvad.
flashing, coruscation, twinkling, glittering, Megh.; Mālatīm.
स्फुरत् mfn. (pr. p. P.) trembling, shaking &c. (see root and cf. comp.)
स्फुरत्—तरंग-जिह्व mfn. having tongue-like tremulous waves (said of a river), Rājat.
स्फुरत्—प्रभा-मण्डल mfn. surrounded by a circle of tremulous light (said of a dart), Ragh.
स्फुरद् in comp. for स्फुरत्.
स्फुरद्—अधरोऽष्ठ mfn. having quivering lips (अम् ind.), MW.
स्फुरद्—अधरोऽष्ठम् ind.
स्फुरद्—उल्का f. a shooting meteor, aerolite, ib.
स्फुरद्—उल्˚काकृति mfn. having the form of a sh˚ meteor, ib.
स्फुरद्—ओष्ठ mf(ई)n. with quivering lip, MBh.
स्फुरद्—ओष्ठक mfn. id., L.
स्फुरद्—गन्ध m. a diffused odour, Bhartṛ.
स्फुरन् in comp. for स्फुरत्.
स्फुरन्—मीन mfn. having glittering fishes, gleaming with fishes, Rājat.
स्फुरमाण mfn. (pr. p. Ā.) trembling, quivering &c.
स्फुरमाणौष्ठ mfn. having quivering lips, R.
स्फुरित mfn. quivering, throbbing, trembling, palpitating, flashing &c., Kāv.; VarBṛS.; Pañcat.
struggling, Vās.
glittered, flashed (n. impers. ‘it has been flashed by’), Hariv.; Kālid.; BhP.
broken forth, burst into view, suddenly arisen or appeared, Kathās.; Sarvad.
plainly displayed or exhibited, Śiś.
swelled, swollen, W.
स्फुरित n. a tremulous or convulsive motion, quiver, throb, twitch, tremor, convulsion, Kālid.; Bhartṛ.
agitation or emotion of mind, MW.
flash, gleam, glittering, radiance, sheen, MBh.; Kathās.
sudden appearance, coming into being, Rājat.
स्फुरित—शतह्रद mfn. having flashing lightning (said of a cloud), ib.
स्फुरिताधर mfn. having lips trembling with (comp.), Kum.
स्फुरितोत्तराधर mfn. having trembling upper and under lip, ib.
स्फूर्त mfn. (accord. to some) throbbed, throbbing, MW.
suddenly risen into remembrance, ib.
स्फूर्ति f. quivering, throbbing, throb, palpitation, tremor, vibration, Bhpr.
breaking forth visibly, sudden appearance or display, manifestation, Kāv.; Rājat.
bragging, boasting, Pañcad.
स्फूर्ति—मत् mfn. throbbing, thrilling (with joy or excitement), tremulous, agitated, W.
tender-hearted, ib.
स्फूर्ति—मत् m. a follower or worshipper of Śiva (= पाशुपत), L.
स्फुर्छ्, स्फुर्ज्. See √ स्फूर्छ्, स्फूर्ज्.

स्फूर्छ् (also written स्वूर्छ्) cl. 1. P. स्फूर्छति, to spread, extend, Dhātup. vii, 33;
to forget, ib.
स्फुर्ज्, स्फुर्छ्. See √ स्फूर्छ्, स्फूर्ज्.

स्फूर्ज् cl. 1. P. (Dhātup. vii, 61) स्फूर्जति (only in pres.; Gr. also pf. पुस्फूर्ज fut. स्फूर्जिता &c.),
to rumble, roar, thunder, crash, Kāv.; Kathās.;
to burst forth, be displayed, appear, ib.; Rājat.; Sāh. :
Caus. स्फूर्ज॑यति (aor. अपुस्फूर्जत्), to crash, crackle, AV.; AitBr. :
Desid. पुस्फूर्जिषति Gr.:
Intens. पोस्फूर्ज्यते, पोस्फूर्क्ति, ib. [cf. Gk. σϕαραγέομαι.]
स्फुल n. a tent (= वस्त्र-वेश्मन्), L.
स्फुल—मञ्जरी f. Achyranthes Aspera, L.
स्फुलन n. trembling, throbbing, vibration (= स्फुरण), L.
स्फुलिङ्ग m. (accord. to L. also n. and f(आ). ; perhaps for स्फुलं-ग) a spark of fire, MBh.; R. &c.
a fire-brand, ĀpŚr., Sch.
स्फुलिङ्ग—वत् mfn. scattering sparks, Śiś.
स्फुलिङ्गक m. a spark of fire, Yājñ.; BhP.
स्फुलिङ्गाय Nom. Ā. ˚यते, to be or burn like sparks of fire, Kāv.
स्फुलिङ्गिन् mfn. having sparks of fire, sparkling, MW.
स्फुलिङ्गिनी (इनी), f. N. of one of the seven tongues of Agni or fire, MuṇḍUp.; MārkP.
स्फूर्छित mfn. spread Gr.
forgotten, ib.
1. स्फूर्ण id., ib.
2. स्फूर्ण mfn. (?) thundered, MW.
स्फूर्ज m. the crashing sound of thunder, thunder-clap, W.
Indra's thunderbolt, ib.
sudden outbreak (cf. नर्म-स्फ्˚)
N. of a Rākṣasa, BhāgP.
a kind of plant (= स्फूर्जक), L.
स्फूर्जा-वत् mfn. thundering, Bhaṭṭ.
स्फू॑र्जक m. a kind of plant (Diospyros Embryopteris, Strychnos &c., L.), ŚBr.; Car.; Suśr.
स्फूर्जथु m. thunder, a thunder-clap, Mcar.
Amaranthus Polygonoides, L.
स्फूर्जन m. = स्फूर्जक, L.
स्फूर्जन n. thundering, explosion, crash (Gk. σϕάραγος), W.
स्फूर्जि See विश्व-स्फ्˚.
स्फूर्जित mfn. thundering
स्फूर्जित n. thunder, a thunder-clap, crash, roar &c., Kāv.
